prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene depicts a busy shipyard dock. On the left stands a man in a blue hard hat, leaning casually against a rusted crane base. In the center, a woman in yellow overalls points firmly toward the horizon, directing attention to the distant water. Next to her on the right, a boy in striped shorts sits patiently on a wooden crate, watching the activity. A brown dog lies calmly beside the boy, resting its head on its paws. Near the foreground edge, an old sailor in a grey coat hands a coiled rope to the man in the blue hard hat, completing the exchange. The woman in yellow overalls looks intently at the boy in striped shorts, ensuring he remains safe. There is no modern machinery visible in this timeless setting. The composition relies on simple lines and faint hues to suggest form without heavy shading. Each figure is distinct through their clothing and posture, creating a balanced triangular arrangement across the dock. The rusted crane provides vertical structure while the horizontal dock planks ground the scene. The interaction between the sailor and the worker suggests ongoing labor, while the guardian-like gaze of the woman adds a layer of care to the industrial environment.
